title: Sacred Geometry Atlas scan, model, and survey evidence register
purpose: Track public evidence for interior and exterior measurement without treating a photograph, a marketing model, or a published dimension as a LiDAR survey.

statusVocabulary.open-download: A public file or dataset is advertised for download; it still requires license and scale/control verification.
statusVocabulary.viewable-model: A public 3D model or viewer is available, but a raw point cloud or reproducible download was not taken here.
statusVocabulary.survey-documented: An institutional or scholarly source documents laser scanning, photogrammetry, or measured survey, but the raw data was not found as an open download.
statusVocabulary.reference-only: Public sources establish the building identity or published facts; no authoritative open scan was located.
statusVocabulary.partial-survey: A survey exists for a defined part of the building or site, not the full church.
statusVocabulary.contact-access: A dataset is described publicly but access requires contacting the data custodian.
